items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: one of the photos he showed me was one from 52nd Street with Coleman Hawkins, Don Bias, Benny Harris, Thelonious Monk, Al Hall and himself... Just any time you catch him sitting in with anybody.

ctx.x: Got a picture of him, Don Byas, Coleman Hawkins and Thelonious Monk.
